## Appearance

Zilla Marsh has a tiny, shriveled frame that gives her a particularly young appearance. Her purple-hued visage features audacious, pale-blue eyes.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P3](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0003)_

## History

Zilla Marsh came from a fishing village situated at the harbor mouth. While barefoot, she received a charitable gift of shoes and stockings from [Grace](../character/grace.md), after which Zilla quickly departed to keep her new possessions safe.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P2](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P11](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P12](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV. A CHARITABLE IMPULSE P37](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER XXIV.
